patches_added.name: Hide ads
patches_added.description: Stops the Google AdMob banners shown to free accounts from loading anywhere in the app. On by default.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings UI integration
patches_modified.description: Integrates Morphe Patches & App Archiving settings directly into Smart Launcher's native Experimental Features settings screen.

patches_added.name: Clean sidebar More menu
patches_added.description: Hides the "Help" section (What's New, Features, FAQ, Check for Update, Bug Report, About) from the sidebar's More menu.

patches_added.name: Configure Smart Enhance toast
patches_added.description: Always skips the Smart Enhance popup animation and always drops the disable-side toast. "Show toast" on: fires a toast when Smart Enhance is enabled. Off: enabling is silent too.

patches_added.name: Configure SpeedUp overlay
patches_added.description: "2x UI": keeps the long-press SpeedUp overlay/animation, with the stock leftover-visible-view bug fixed. "No UI": the overlay never shows at all - the speed change itself still applies, since that's handled elsewhere.

patches_added.name: Default Shortcuts
patches_added.description: Changes which player long-press/gesture shortcuts are enabled out of the box, for installs that have never customized them (Settings > Player > Customize Shortcuts still works normally and always wins once touched). Default keeps screen rotation, playback speed, background play, loop, customize items, screenshot, mirror mode and vertical flip; drops mute, shuffle, equalizer, sleep timer, repeat A-B, night mode and audio effect.

patches_added.name: Disable Smart Enhance popup
patches_added.description: Skips the "Smart Enhance" intro dialog on the player menu - tapping the menu item toggles Smart Enhance directly instead of showing the popup first.

patches_added.name: Open subtitle settings by default
patches_added.description: Expands the Sync/Speed/Panel/Customization settings block in the subtitle menu by default instead of it being collapsed.

patches_modified.name: Add Network Stream To Me Tab
patches_modified.description: WARNING MX PLAYER HAS INTEGRITY CHECK. Mod By Youarefinished Also Has Their Own Integrity Check. So Download From Play Store, Use URV Manager With Signing Turned Off, Patch And Then Kill Signature Verification With MT Manager Enhanced (VIP Only) Or Modded Build.

patches_added.name: Comment sort controls
patches_added.description: Exposes TikTok's native full comment-sort sheet, including its hot, time, media, and creator modes, instead of relying on rollout gates.
